title: Companies (Management and Administration) Second Amendment Rules, 2018 — Rule 18 amendment

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Gazette of India
content.citation: G.S.R. 560(E), 13 June 2018, Companies (Management and Administration) Second Amendment Rules, 2018, rule 2(iii)
content.note: The official notification states that in rule 18(3), the Explanation after clause (ix) is omitted. This confirms that specific deletion only; it does not by itself certify the entire consolidated current Rule 18 or every amendment affecting the Rules.
